name: Sleeve's 15-min ORB on 3x funds, ORB-mid stop, 1R/2R/EOD, market filter, 10:30 cutoff
hypothesis: Opening-range breakouts on leveraged funds have positive expectancy when aligned with the market
notes: Filter helps directionally (no-filter -0.12R, t -1.78) but no significant edge.

author: main
name: Stocks-in-play 5-min ORB, long only, top-K by relative volume
hypothesis: Zarattini-Barbon-Aziz 2024: high relative-volume stocks continue after the opening range
method: K in 1,3,5,10,20 x entry (9:35 open, buy-stop) x stop (OR low, 10/25% ATR, none); 10bp
notes: No variant positive after costs; RV buckets non-monotonic. Retest on multi-year data.

name: Fama-MacBeth: 9:45 features -> 9:45-15:55 return
hypothesis: Gap, first-15m return, RV, prior-day return, 5-day return, dist to 20d high, ATR%, dollar volume predict rest-of-day
method: daily cross-sectional OLS on ranks; long-only deciles; 10bp

name: Overnight vs intraday decomposition (SPY, QQQ, IWM; 3x funds)
hypothesis: Equity premium accrues overnight (Cliff-Cooper-Gulen 2008; Lou-Polk-Skouras 2019; Boyarchenko-Larsen-Whelan 2023)
notes: Strong, persistent, consistent with decades of literature.

name: Overnight conditional on same-day direction (down vs up days)

author: main
name: 3x overnight overlays: vol target 1%, 200-day trend, both (SPY, QQQ, IWM)
hypothesis: Trend filters and vol-managed exposure improve risk-adjusted overnight premium
notes: Trend filter robust in both halves; vol targeting alone does not raise Sharpe.

author: main
name: Vol target 1.0/1.5/2.0% per night + trend; QQQ-only vs equal thirds SPY/QQQ/IWM
hypothesis: Size to the user's $100 worst-night limit
notes: Chosen live spec: equal thirds, 1.5%/night target, cap 3x, 200-day filter.

author: main
name: Below-200-day nights: inverse funds overnight?
notes: Overnight ~0 below the 200-day: cash is right.

author: main
name: Fill realism for the overnight model: ~15:58 buy vs official close, 9:30 first print vs official open
hypothesis: Backtests on official close/open prices are achievable with a 15:58 marketable limit buy and a market sell queued for the open
method: 15:55-bar midpoint as the 15:58 price; first 5m open as the opening fill
notes: Execution adds ~0 bias and 12-19bp noise per leg per night; 4bp cost assumption stands. Note: TQQQ nights averaged -17bp over these 59 sessions (recent weakness).
